rules.statement: A claim of prescriptive rights to a road access requires clear and unmistakable evidence of the commencement of an adverse user for a prescriptive period.
rules.supporting_quote: In view of the above findings, I am of the view that the learned District Judge was correct in determining that the defendants had failed to prove that they have acquired prescriptive rights to a road access 6 feet in width. I find that the learned Judges of the High Court had failed to consider this important factor in relation to a claim based on prescription.
